subject: UPPER-CASE function
notes: kb/Work PB64 T5 (2026-08-19) — LANDED; was DIVERGES (the CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION clause was swallowed silently, then refused by name). Without a LOCALE phrase, in a module whose (own or inherited) CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION puts a locale in effect for the operand's class, the correspondence is that locale's LC_CTYPE — UPPER-CASE("i") → U+0130 under CLASSIFICATION IS TR (UP-I), and under CLASSIFICATION IS LOCALE the locale current at the module's ACTIVATION (INNER = 305 vs OUTER-2 = 74). Rule --check verified at 15.97.4 3).
